blocks.text:
Early in the morning, you’ll take a hot-air balloon flight over the canyon. You’ll watch the sunrise from the air as the sun and white clouds rise above the canyon.

After the flight, you’ll transfer to the national park. We’ll follow several fairly short trails to see the most scenic stretches of the canyon from different viewpoints. A picnic is planned on the canyon rim, overlooking cliffs, gorges and clouds.

blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Transfer to Florianopolis. Arrival and check-in at the hotel.

Florianópolis is known for its many beaches. Some are good for relaxing, others for surfing or photographing the high waves. The city also has historic landmarks dating back to its founding in the early eighteenth century.
